issues: React Native Web still emits deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props (use boxShadow) — carried over from iter1/iter2, non-blocking.

New Reanimated warning appears twice on mount: '[Reanimated] Property [transform] may be overwritten by a layout animation. Please wrap your component with an animated view and apply the layout animation on the wrapper.' Likely caused by combining an entering= layout animation with a useAnimatedStyle transform on the same view (e.g. staggered breakdown bars or parallax hero). Non-blocking (animations still play) but should be fixed by moving the layout animation onto a wrapper Animated.View.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Silence RN Web 'shadow*' deprecation by replacing shadow{Color,Offset,Opacity,Radius} with the single boxShadow style prop.

(Optional/cosmetic) Wrap components that use both `entering=` layout animation and `useAnimatedStyle` transform with an outer Animated.View — apply the entering animation on the wrapper and keep the transform on the inner view. This will remove the two Reanimated warnings on mount.
No functional fixes required. All 15 backend tests + full frontend flow green.
